pathAssistantSteps.info:
To complete the prequalification, please fill in the following fields:

  • Estimated volume: Coffee ✅
  • Estimated sales: Tea ✅
  • Estimated sales: Hot Chocolate ✅

Please also ensure that:

  • a postal code ✅

is entered in the address details.


Based on this information, the potential revenue will be calculated and the lead will be evaluated. The status will update automatically once all required information has been completed.

To complete the sales qualification, please fill in the following fields:

  • Sales Category ✅
  • Legal Form ✅


Please also ensure that:

  • the lead’s chain affiliation has been clarified and documented ✅


Once all required information has been completed and the chain affiliation has been confirmed, the lead record can be converted.

To proceed to the next status, please complete the following information:

  • Complete name (Salutation, First name, Last name) ✅
  • Valid email address ✅
  • At least one phone number
    • Phone or ✅
    • Mobile ✅


Once all mandatory fields are completed, the status will update automatically.
Hooray! You have a new deal to bring across the finish line.
